answer: Make endorsement conserve weight instead of minting it: to vouch you transfer a slice of your OWN earned weight down the edge, decaying at each hop out from the honest core. Weight is a fixed harvest from one orchard, never created by vouching. A farm's thousand heads can endorse each other in a saffron-bright lattice, yet they only pass the same small pie in circles; with no inflow from the core their shared weight sinks to its nadir. An honest agent draws fresh weight from core peers who spend real stake to vouch, so only endorsements that cost the endorser ever move true weight.
